description: The grid cases of the layout model. Each case builds a grid from state and options and runs its steps in order: get and set read and write a property, any other call is the method of that name with args. A step with returns gives that value, numbers within a relative 1e-9; a step with throws fails with that message; a step with neither gives no value. A case with throws fails at the construction.

cases.name: a grid without a state is one card filling the plane
the options set the gap, the minimum, the grab size, the snap and the plane
options that are not numbers in range keep the defaults
the setters refuse a value out of range and keep the one set
a state with one line is refused
cases.throws: soksak: xs needs at least two lines

cases.name: a state with lines out of order is refused
a state with no cards is refused
a card without an id is refused
cases.throws: soksak: a card has no id

cases.name: two cards with one id are refused
cases.throws: soksak: two cards are called a

cases.name: a card outside the lines is refused
a card with no span is refused
cases.throws: soksak: a.r1 is not past a.r0

cases.name: the reads of a plane of three cards
a drop lands on the centre or the nearest side of the card under it
the card setters change one card and refuse an unknown one
splits cut a card into two and the new card takes the far half
a split toward a side puts the new card on that side
a split refuses halves below the minimum
a split of a card with a px size divides the size
a close returns the space to the card it came from
a close lets a row of neighbours fill the space
a close in the h order fills from the side first
a close of a card that no row fills removes its slots
a dragged boundary moves its line within the range and snaps onto a neighbour
a boundary beside a px size changes the size
two px sizes on one boundary trade their sizes
merge, tidy and balance keep the arrangement
balance gives the cards of the fullest row one size and keeps a px size
an insert places a plane-spanning card at a boundary
an insert that no neighbour can pay for takes the span from every slot
a move takes a card to a side of another and keeps its id and payload
